name: Power Integrations, Inc.
blurb: Power Integrations designs and markets analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits used in high-voltage power conversion. Its chips are embedded in AC-DC power supplies for consumer electronics, mobile chargers, appliances, industrial equipment, and communications infrastructure. The company is known for its EcoSmart energy-efficiency technology and a broad portfolio of power IC families (TOPSwitch, TinySwitch, LinkSwitch, and others). It occupies a niche leadership position in the market for compact, efficient offline power converters.
recent: Power Integrations reported Q1 2026 results with revenue of $108.31 million and net income of $3.3 million, reflecting modest top-line growth but compressed profitability. The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.215 per share, payable June 30, 2026, signaling continued shareholder returns. It also appointed Michael Balow as Senior Vice President of Worldwide Sales, a move analysts are watching as a potential catalyst for accelerating revenue growth.
